summary: The candidate is a meaningful partial fix: its L3 classifications, legacy HiRadixCache snapshot, ordinary write/load acknowledgement metrics, and focused regressions pass. It does not provide full-lifecycle observability because UnifiedRadixCache decode-retraction performs real L1-to-L2 and L2-to-L1 transfers without the new metric or rid events, and ordinary L1/L2 logs do not provide truthful request-correlated terminal outcomes.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: RadixCacheMetricsCollector lacked the transfer-result API; StorageMetrics lacked prefetch_stats; neither cache had structured HICACHE rid events. Evidence: reports/j-ac42bbbc76bb/evidence/base-contract-probe.log
17 candidate collector tests passed, including L3 delta/reset behavior and the newly exposed ordinary transfer counter API. Evidence: reports/j-ac42bbbc76bb/evidence/candidate-observability.log

13 passed and 6 repository-gated skips on one AMD GPU; exercised file-backed L3 query, host staging, GPU load-back, exact K/V comparison, and candidate hit-stat export. Evidence: reports/j-ac42bbbc76bb/evidence/candidate-unified-gpu.log
4 legacy HiRadixCache tests passed on the assigned AMD GPU. Evidence: reports/j-ac42bbbc76bb/evidence/candidate-hiradix.log

2 tests passed on the assigned AMD GPU, confirming the supported UnifiedRadixCache retraction path performs capacity handling and exact target+draft L1/L2 round trips. Evidence: reports/j-ac42bbbc76bb/evidence/candidate-retraction-gpu.log

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ac42bbbc76bb/venv/bin/python independent recorder probe wrapping test_decode_retraction_backup operations
tests.what_was_measured: Candidate counterexample: a real host-capacity-declined retraction backup and a successful target+draft backup/restore both emitted zero transfer-result metric calls. Evidence: reports/j-ac42bbbc76bb/evidence/candidate-adversarial-retraction.log
Candidate diff has no whitespace errors. Evidence: reports/j-ac42bbbc76bb/evidence/diff-check.log

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X; Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; HIP 7.2.26015. Direct file-storage, legacy cache, and decode-retraction tests ran on this device.
remaining_counterexamples: UnifiedRadixCache.retraction_backup returns None on real host-capacity exhaustion without incrementing hicache_transfer_requests_total for L1-to-L2 failure.
A successful UnifiedRadixCache retraction_backup plus retraction_restore target+draft GPU round trip emits no L1-to-L2 or L2-to-L1 transfer-result metric.
The retraction path has req.rid but emits no unified [HICACHE] rid lifecycle records.

Ordinary init_load_back logs tier=l1 result=complete unconditionally rather than classifying L1 hit/miss and hit tokens, and its L2-to-L1 record is scheduled rather than a request-correlated terminal result.
Unexpected asynchronous transfer exceptions are still process errors without failure counter events.
remaining_limitations: No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
Mooncake, HF3FS, NIXL, UMBP, multi-node, TP/PP distributed, model-specific storage paths, and NVIDIA/CUDA were unavailable and remain unverified.
The one-GPU tests validate cache transport and exact fixture K/V restoration, not HTTP serving or model semantic accuracy.
NUMA balancing was enabled on the node; the prepared runtime emitted the standard ROCm performance warning, but all selected GPU compatibility tests completed.
